extension.description: IMDb ratings and vote counts from IMDb's ratings dataset, updated when IMDb publishes a new one.
extension.disclaimer: Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - New lookup() reads a stored rating without updating, and StoreError separates a store problem from a missing rating - Works from any thread of an add-on, not only the one that first used it - A damaged store is rebuilt and the dataset downloaded again - Only a dataset newer than the stored one is loaded - A stopped download or a failing abort callback no longer delays updates for every add-on - A failed first download retries after 15 minutes, doubling up to 6 hours - Kodi stopping an add-on during the update check no longer starts a download - A download stopped by Kodi's kill no longer leaves the store locked - Malformed or oversized ids return None instead of raising or matching another title - One malformed row no longer fails the whole download - Repeated store errors are logged once
